name: C51
tagline: Categorical DQN: predict a discrete distribution over a fixed atom support and minimize cross-entropy after Bellman projection.
pseudocode:
1. Network outputs logits over $N\!=\!51$ atoms $z_k\in[V_{\min},V_{\max}]=[-10,10]$ per action; pmf $p_a = \mathrm{softmax}(\text{logits}_a)$, $Q(s,a)=\sum_k z_k p_a(s,k)$.
2. Greedy action: $a^*=\arg\max_a Q(s',a)$ from target net.
3. Bellman atoms: $T z_k = r + \gamma(1-d) z_k$, clamp to $[V_{\min},V_{\max}]$.
4. Categorical projection $\Phi$ onto $\{z_k\}$ via floor/ceil interpolation.
5. Loss: $-\sum_k (\Phi p_{\text{target}})_k \log p_{\text{online}}(s,a;k)$.
6. Hard target update every 10000 steps; Adam lr $=2.5\!\times\!10^{-4}$, eps $=0.01/B$.
diff_from_baseline: Bellemare, Dabney, Munos, 'A Distributional Perspective on Reinforcement Learning' (ICML 2017). Distributional value head over a fixed support — replaces scalar Q regression with categorical cross-entropy.

name: Double DQN
tagline: Decouples action selection (online net) from action evaluation (target net) to reduce overestimation bias.
diff_from_baseline: van Hasselt, Guez, Silver, 'Deep Reinforcement Learning with Double Q-learning' (AAAI 2016). Same encoder/head as DQN; only the bootstrap target changes.

name: QR-DQN
tagline: Distributional DQN with quantile regression: learn N quantile values per action and optimize the quantile Huber loss.

key_hyperparams.name: n_quantiles
key_hyperparams.role: Atari setting from Dabney et al.

diff_from_baseline: Dabney, Rowland, Bellemare, Munos, 'Distributional Reinforcement Learning with Quantile Regression' (AAAI 2018). Drops C51's bounded support requirement by representing the distribution as quantiles instead of categorical atoms.
